**Group:** Artifacts  ·  **Optics:** high-mag, low-mag

## Defining characteristics

A non-biological imaging artifact: an air bubble in the sample or optics, appearing as a smooth, near-perfect circle with a bright refractive rim and a uniform (often dark or empty) interior, with no cellular structure. Exclude from biological analysis. Key features: perfect circle, bright ring/edge, featureless interior.

## Distinguishing from similar classes

| Similar class | How to tell them apart |
|---|---|
| **circle_1** | Both are round artifacts; a bubble shows a bright refractive rim and empty interior, distinct from the circle_1 pattern (see reference images). |
| **noctiluca** | Noctiluca is a large round living cell with a granular interior and a tentacle; a bubble is featureless with a bright refractive rim. |
